findings.message: This signature still promises a plain number, but area() now rounds, so it returns an integer. Callers that composed it with scaleRect or compared two areas for equality silently change behaviour, and nothing in the type tells them. Either name the rounding in the return type or do it at the call site.
Changing <= to < makes a rectangle no longer fit inside itself, so fits(r, r) is now false. Exact-fit is the common case for layout and packing code, and this reads as a typo rather than a decision.
inner and outer read as interchangeable at the call site. containee/container, or a doc comment naming which argument is the bounding box, would stop the arguments being swapped.
